The '''91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps''', known simply as the '''91st Reconnaissance Corps''' or the '''91st Recon Corps''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Corps/Legends|corps]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that specialized in [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]]. It contained [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], a renowned [[scout squadron]] of [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]], and fell under the leadership of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], and eventually [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

Having joined [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]]' multi-unit task force on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] towards the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end of the war]], the 91st Reconnaissance Corps participated in the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], helping secure the planet for the Republic. Following the end of the battle and the activation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the 91st Reconnaissance Corps' clone troopers turned on [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Stass Allie, [[Death/Legends|killing]] her with [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] during a patrol. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the 91st Recon Corps continued to serve under the new [[Dictatorship/Legends|Imperial regime]], in the newly formed [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Description==
===Structure===
====Republic command====
[[File:Stak_helmet.png|thumb|left|200px|Lightning Squadron (member pictured) was part of the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps.]]
The 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps,<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> referred to simply as the 91st Reconnaissance Corps and the 91st Recon Corps,<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> was a [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] twenty [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Armies]]. The corps was made up of four [[Legion/Legends|legions]], totaling 36,864 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],<ref name="Composition" /> counting a number of [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commandos]],<ref name="SWE3" /> plus support personnel,<ref name="Composition" /> including the [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] prior to his transfer to [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]].<ref name="SWE Neyo" /> 

The 91st Recon Corps fell under the leadership of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]],<ref name="Sideshow Neyo" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]<ref name="Nomad Droids EG" /> prior to her death,<ref name="TCW Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref> and eventually [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] after the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|fall of Saleucami]].<ref name="Sideshow Neyo" /> While stationed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], the 91st Recon Corps fell under the command of Jedi General [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] as part of his multi-unit task force, alongside the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]].<ref name="DB Neyo" />

The 91st Recon Corps also contained [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], an elite [[scout squadron]] containing ten [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> including troopers [[Stak/Legends|Stak]] and [[Razor/Legends|Razor]],<ref name="TCW LOR">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> assigned to carry out special reconnaissance missions using [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]]. The squadron was led by a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] and two [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeants]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

====Imperial rule====
Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule, the 91st Recon Corps continued to serve as a military reconnaissance force under the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], retaining most of its organizational structure.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] Neyo continued to serve as the unit's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]].<ref name="Insider 87 Order 66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref>

===Equipment and vehicles===
[[File:NeyoHS-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|The 91st Recon Corps' clone troopers were distinguished by the red sigils adorning their armor.]]
The 91st Recon Corps' clone troopers wore standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with its left [[Limb/Legends|shoulderplate]] painted [[Color/Legends|maroon]], while the rest of the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was adorned with four, circular red sigils,<ref name="TCW Nomad Droids" /> which identified the unit's troopers as members of the 91st. The corps' [[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Biker Advanced Recon Commandos]] wore specialized [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] with narrow visors, similar to the helmets worn by [[clone assassin]]s. Additionally, the 91st's BARC troopers wore [[ARC command sash]]es identifying them as [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]]<ref name="FF19">{{FactFile2014|19|NEY 1-4|Commander Neyo}}</ref> and were sometimes equipped with maroon [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].<ref name="SWMini Saleucami Trooper">{{SWMiniCite|set=Champions of the Force|pack=Saleucami Trooper}}</ref> Out of staunch loyalty, the corps' [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone lieutenants]] wore identical helmets to their marshal commander's, in order to make it harder for the enemy to target him.<ref name="Vehicles 43">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 43|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 43]]</ref> Clone troopers in the unit also wielded [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], and [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]] in combat.<ref name="Sideshow Neyo" />

The 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps utilized various ground vehicles for reconnaissance, including [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]]<ref name="91st ATRT" /> and [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|All Terrain Attack Pod]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] adorned with 91st sigils.<ref name="91st ATAP" /> The corps' BARC troopers often piloted [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]].<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
===Origins===
The 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps was a military [[Corps/Legends|corps]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an [[Galaxy/Legends|inter-galactic]] war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Following the completion of [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17's]] [[ARC program/Legends|ARC training program]] on the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] was promoted to the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] rank of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] and given command of the 91st Reconnaissance Corps.<ref name="Sideshow Neyo" /> The 91st eventually began serving under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] as well.<ref name="TCW Nomad Droids" />

===Ambush near Patitite Pattuna===
{{Quote|They've hit the main reactor. Prepare to evacuate.|Adi Gallia ordering the 91st Reconnaissance Corps to evacuate her flagship.|<ref name="TCW Nomad Droids" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Adi Gallia and the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps began to return to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard [[Adi Gallia's flagship/Legends|Adi Gallia's flagship]], a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="FF-2014 25: Gallia">{{FactFile2014|25|GAL 1-4|Adi Gallia}}</ref> after having assisted with [[Mission to Aleen|relief efforts]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]].<ref name="SWE Adi Gallia" /> 

[[File:91stBattle-ND.png|thumb|left|300px|The 91st Recon Corps engages General Grievous and his forces aboard Adi Gallia's flagship.]]
During the trip, the 91st's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was ambushed near the Mid Rim world [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and one [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. A [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|battle]] quickly broke out between the [[Warship/Legends|warships]], with the Confederacy managing to damage the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire, forcing Adi Gallia to order her [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to evacuate. While evacuation efforts were underway, with 91st personnel evacuating aboard [[Space gunship/Legends|space gunships]], General Grievous boarded Adi Gallia's Jedi cruiser and engaged her in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] in one of the cruiser's corridors, while six 91st [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] fended off against [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] who were flanking the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] general. Four of the 91st's clone troopers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and Adi Gallia was eventually captured by General Grievous, who brought her aboard his [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)|dreadnought]] as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. A while later, Adi Gallia was [[Rescue of Adi Gallia/Legends|rescued]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and his [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]].<ref name="TCW Nomad Droids" /> 

A year later, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> the 91st's [[Tholothian/Legends|Tholothian]] general died during a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|skirmish]] with the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="TCW Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>

===WAC-47 and the D-Squad===
{{Quote|WAC-47, reporting for duty!|WAC-47|<ref name="TCW Secret Weapons" />}}
[[File:WAC47-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|WAC-47 was drafted by Colonel Meebur Gascon from the 91st Reconnaissance Corps to join D-Squad.]]
In the same year as Adi Gallia's death,<ref name="Secret Weapons Date">{{FactFile2014|58|DSQ 1-2|D-Squad}}</ref> the 91st Recon Corps' [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]],<ref name="SWE Neyo" /> a [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] assigned to Neyo, was drafted by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] to join [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], a [[Special forces/Legends|special missions]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of droids. The squad was brought together to [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|steal]] a Separatist [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] in order to decode a transmission from General Grievous that [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] was unable to decipher. Clone Commander Neyo brought the pit droid to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a meeting discussing the mission, but both arrived late as WAC-47 confused the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]] for the Jedi storeroom. The pair were then briefed for the mission and WAC-47 was sent to meet with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gubacher/Legends|Gubacher]], before being sent by Colonel Gascon to prepare the mission's [[D-Squad's Maxillipede shuttle|shuttle]].<ref name="TCW Secret Weapons" />

Later, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Neyo participated in the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]] aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. While waiting for the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer [[Renown/Legends|''Renown'']] to arrive to the meeting, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] blew up and debris began to ravage the station, as the ''Valor'' had been turned into a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] by the Separatists, using large amounts of [[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] from the planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]. The attack was created as a [[Carida Incident|plot]] to destroy the space station and to kill the high ranking military officials that were attending the conference. Due to the efforts of D-Squad and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] preemptive detonation of the [[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] aboard the ship, the station and the 91st Recon Corps' commanding officer were saved from the Separatist [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt.<ref name="TCW PoNR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>

===End of the war===
In 20 BBY,<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]—which the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps fought numerous battles in,<ref name="SWCE" /> the Galactic Republic conducted a [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|siege]] of the Separatist-controlled planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], with Jedi General [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] conducting the operation. The 91st Reconnaissance Corps, alongside the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] and Commander [[Faie/Legends|Faie's]] forces, participated in the siege under the command of General Rancisis, as one of the units in his multi-unit task force. Having fought Separatist battle droids and the cloned [[Morgukai Shadow Army]], the 91st and the rest of the task force were successful and the planet was eventually won by the Galactic Republic.<ref name="DB Neyo" /> 

[[File:StassAllieDeath.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Neyo and CT-3423 prepare to execute Stass Allie following the activation of Order 66.]]
Following the battles end, the 91st Recon Corps was assigned to Jedi General [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie's]] command and ordered to patrol the planet's surface for any remaining Separatist holdouts and escaped [[Morgukai]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. During one of these patrols in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] enemies of the Republic and executed [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], ordering the Republic's clone troopers to execute their Jedi leaders. Neyo and [[CT-3423]],<ref name="SWE3" /> under the influence of the [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chips]] implanted in them at birth by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]],<ref name="TCW Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> fired their [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] at Stass Allie, destroying her [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] and killing her in the process.<ref name="SWE3" />

Following Stass Allie's death, and the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="SWE3" /> and the Republic Grand Army's forces were distributed amongst the newly formed [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps was assigned to the Imperial Army branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> and continued to serve under the command of Marshal Commander Neyo.<ref name="Insider 87 Order 66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|III}}, a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" /> The corps was identified as the 91st Reconnaissance Corps in "[[Order 66: Destroy All Jedi]]", a [[2006]] reference article written by [[Daniel Wallace]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 87|eighty-seventh issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''.<ref name="Insider 87 Order 66" /> The corps later received its full identification as the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps in the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', a [[2014]] reference book also written by Daniel Wallace.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
